 Aside from passing references to its English translation terminology, the discourse receives no detailed thematic treatment in the retrieved secondary literature, which primarily concerns the commentarial fivefold *niyāma* scheme or Mahāyāna conceptions of bodhisattva assurance.

 Within the Pali canon, DharmaNexus identifies extensive formulaic text reuse, recording 289 matching segments across 23 other Pali works [DharmaNexus]. The closest textual affinities occur with other dialectical controversies within the *Kathāvatthu*, led by the *Aparāpisamannāgatakathā* (Kv 4.9; 22 matches, longest §11.4–11.7 ↔ §9.4–10.5), the *Atītakkhandhādikathā* (Kv 1.7; 37 matches), the *Vimuttikathā* (Kv 5.1; 9 matches), the *Jhānantarikakathā* (Kv 18.7; 27 matches), and the closely related *Niyatassaniyāmakathā* (Kv 13.4; 21 matches) [DharmaNexus]. Material is also shared with early foundational debates including the *Puggalakathā* (Kv 1.1) and *Parihānikathā* (Kv 1.2), as well as the commentary *Pañcapakaraṇa-aṭṭhakathā* (12 matches) [DharmaNexus].
